_purpose: Dishes, stored as amounts only. Every macro is derived by scripts/adapt_recipe.py from data/foods.json — the same rule the Asian Base Block follows. Nobody types a calorie figure for a dish.
_workflow: 1. Find a recipe anywhere. Keep the link.
2. Add it here as ingredients + grams + steps. Amounts as found, not as wished.
3. Run scripts/adapt_recipe.py. It scales the protein and fibre sources to hit the target and reports what it changed.
4. Cook it. If the real thing differs, fix the grams here, not the macros.

_schema.title: display name
_schema.slot: mirror | breakfast | snack — mirror dishes are adapted to profiles.mirrorMeals
_schema.person: philipp | eunice | null — null means both, which is the point of a mirror meal
_schema.servings: how many portions the amounts below produce
_schema.blocks: Asian Base blocks per serving; 0 for dishes that carry their own carb
_schema.source: where it came from — a link, or who it belongs to
_schema.ingredients: [{ food: id from foods.json, g: grams, note?: 'as bought' }]
_schema.steps: Ninja OL750 method, numbered, with mode/level/time where it matters
_schema.computed: written by the script — do not edit by hand
_schema.adapted: written by the script — what it had to change to hit the target

recipes.title: The Savoury Tub — Lentils, Turkey & Pepper
recipes.source: the savoury alternative to the sweet batch tub, same slot in the day

Drain the lentils, dice the pepper, slice the spring onion into rings
Grate the ginger and garlic fine and stir them into the soy sauce — WITHOUT the sesame oil
Combine everything, into ONE tub, chill. 4 portions, keeps 3 days
The sesame oil goes over each portion as you serve it, about 3 g. In the batch it oxidises over three days and turns from nutty to stale
A lemon wedge at the bowl for whoever wants one. Not in the tub: without acid the salad is flat for Philipp, with it unpleasant for Eunice — the one place this cannot be solved jointly

recipes.title: The Batch Tub — Skyr, Chocolate & Nut
recipes.source: the shared afternoon building block — one bowl, three days, both of them
steps: Dry first: mix the whey, oat bran, flaxseed, cocoa, cinnamon and salt thoroughly
Stir the nut butter smooth with TWO thirds of the almond milk — only then into the skyr, or it stays lumpy
Stir in the dry mix and the vanilla extract, let it swell 20–30 min, then stir AGAIN
Into ONE bowl (~1.5 kg), chill. 9 portions: Philipp 2 a day, Eunice 1. A portion is about 155 g
The last third of the almond milk stays in the fridge. Oat bran and flaxseed keep swelling for three days — from day 2 stir a splash into each portion and the texture is back to day 1
Fold the banana in only as you eat, about 30 g. For more fibre, take 80 g frozen berries instead
